method: Owner's Chrome over CDP via the project's open_page, 2026-10-30 at 08:25 UTC. Five tile wrappers sliced verbatim from the rendered raw capture: two item.taobao.com products, two detail.tmall.com products and one disjoint id-bearing click.simba.taobao.com ad. Only image src/data-src values and SVG bodies removed; tile structure, title nodes, split price parts, shops, sales and locations preserved. The outer document is a minimal offline wrapper. Ground truth read from the raw page before trimming; scripts are not executed and no resources are fetched. Ad trackers are retained only as offline negative evidence, never followed. The brief's link counts describe distinct URLs; the raw DOM repeats product anchors three times and contains two distinct ad URLs per ad tile.
